# CI/CD Workflows

Planned GitHub Actions stages: format/lint/type checks, unit/contract/integration tests, dependency and image scans, IaC validation, RAG evaluation gates, build/push, staged deploy, smoke test, and rollback.

**Status**: Workflow YAML is deferred until the Phase 4 build and test commands are defined. Use OIDC short-lived AWS credentials rather than repository-stored cloud access keys.
